specs.title: upcoming event actions work by keyboard without overflowing the mobile card
Studio keeps an offline draft, restores after reload and saves it on reconnection
professional ticket setup exposes three canonical stages and preserves nested allocation/review
a stale run control cannot retain authority after its creator loses membership

suites.title: Account preferences on the production PWA

specs.title: preferences persist through the real action; dialog fits phone and tablet orientations

suites.title: PWA completed planning and request controls

specs.title: date-impact dialog opens from Plan and changes an uncommitted event preserving local time and duration
date RPC denies a different owner and direct edits cannot bypass provider commitments
London booking availability sees the actual summer window without exposing private calendar blocks
request selections, strategy and priority survive reload and create the authoritative ordered request
a customer can attach a brief and request a hold without a saved card
a current quote state offers secure checkout without requiring a saved card
private request attachment downloads permit the recipient and deny another user and forged metadata
event file uploads are private, share with authorized members and reject forged or replaced sources
